_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Refresh updates the Slack destinations, and goes back to the list when the selected one is detached. The VM starts with one integration, a personal Slack hook "slack-hook". Call "attach team hook" attaches a team Slack hook also named "slack-hook"; call "detach team hook" detaches it again. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and select slack-hook. 2. Fill "#slack-message" with "Keep this draft". 3. Call "attach team hook", then click the refresh button. The texts of "#slack-hook option" should be exactly ["slack-hook · Personal", "slack-hook · Team"], and "#slack-message" should have the value exactly "Keep this draft". 4. Select the option with value "team:slack-hook" of "#slack-hook" (fill it with that value). 5. Call "detach team hook", then click the refresh button. There should be exactly 1 ".integrations-name-btn" and no ".integrations-detail" (count 0). 6. Click the ".integrations-name-btn": the texts of "#slack-hook option" should be exactly ["slack-hook · Personal"].
